class_balance: balanced (35/40/25) + class_weight; psychometrics derived from behaviour (train/serve aligned)

calibration.fit: held-out split the RF never trained on (FrozenEstimator, prefit)
calibration.note: Calibrates the served probability only; the RF used for SHAP/feature-importances is unchanged.

data_note: Trained and evaluated on synthetic/illustrative data with realistic class overlap; a screening signal, not a validated clinical instrument.
evaluation_note: Held-out 20% split (seed=42) the model never trained on. Psychometric features use the shared derive_psychometrics() — identical in training and serving.

chat_metrics.model: LogisticRegression + TF-IDF (word 1-2gram + char_wb 3-5gram union) + isotonic calibration
chat_metrics.note: Balanced split flatters the model; the realistic set reflects the true ~imbalanced stream. Toxic precision is low at 0.5 (the model over-flags gaming language), which is exactly why the live alert threshold is 0.9 (higher precision, lower recall). The real fix is real gaming-chat data.
chat_metrics.eval: Held-out rows the deployed model never trained on (seeds match retrain).

voice_metrics.model: HistGradientBoosting on 36 acoustic features (REAL audio: RAVDESS/CREMA-D/EMO-DB/URDU)
voice_metrics.eval: Held-out 20% of real labelled speech, SPEAKER-INDEPENDENT split (no speaker appears in both train and test), features via the SERVING extractor.
voice_metrics.note: Acted-emotion corpora (adult, studio conditions) — closer to reality than synthetic features, but child gaming speech remains the validation target.

model_features: objective-10: the 10 psychometric proxies are deterministic functions of these (behavior_features.py) and are excluded from the model input to keep SHAP attributions non-circular; they remain as UI-level explanations

chat_metrics_gaming.scoring: as served: clean_text -> TF-IDF -> LogReg + isotonic fused with keyword lexicon (noisy-OR)
chat_metrics_gaming.note: In-DOMAIN evaluation on real in-game chat — the honest complement to the general-corpus metrics in chat_metrics. Use best_f1_threshold to inform CHAT_ALERT_T (env-overridable), alongside the false-alarm evidence from ml/tune_from_feedback.py.
